decisions.reason: The garage door operator line remains a core complement to the firm's garage-door systems offering, so a large German supplier would usually retain and update it rather than withdraw it.
The solid wood sectional garage door is comparatively niche and costlier to sustain, but it still fits the firm's customization promise for homeowner projects and premium architectural demand.

This glazed industrial sectional door appears the most vulnerable because it overlaps with stronger industrial glazed offerings and is the likeliest candidate for range simplification and resource reallocation.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door matches the firm's compliance, thermal-performance and industrial-building focus, so management would generally continue it unless demand clearly weakens.
As a prominently positioned glazed industrial sectional door, it supports the firm's one-source industrial access range and is more likely to be kept than removed.
